checkpoint_selection: Lexicographic maximum of full validation available-exchange task successes, overall task successes, negative exchange-as-return cases, negative weighted completion loss. Only positive callback checkpoints 119/239 are eligible. Final update 240 weights are retained but are not a selection candidate. No test output before selection finishes.
runtime_policy: All three arms share the unchanged v2 WorkflowStore, prompt, tools, decoding and budgets. No keyword routing or forced exchange action.
promotion_rule: Available exchange task success must improve over v2 and be no worse than base; zero exchange-as-return cases on available exchanges; overall task success no lower than either comparator; direct return success no worse than base; confirmation preserved on every task. A predeclared local prototype criterion, not a production or statistical guarantee. Ordinary exchanges must all pass; no paired non-exchange regressions against base.
